_meta.purpose: Golden fixtures for gradeCompleteness() — input-VAT completeness engine (PLAN_ledger_tax_invoice.md §3 / §7).
_meta.shape: each .input matches CompletenessInput; .expect asserts {status, buyerMatch, blockReason}
notes: GROUP_TAX_IDS in the real code currently holds ONLY our own id (0305564001581).
Therefore a *different* group company's id is NOT whitelisted yet -> it lands on R3 buyer_mismatch (still RED), not R2 wrong_entity.
R2 (wrong_entity) is effectively unreachable until CEO supplies the full group whitelist (Open#1). This is correct per real code; PLAN row R2 is aspirational.
All lures must grade red_invalid (zero false-accept). vat=0 must never be green. abbreviated -> yellow. name-wrong-but-taxid-right -> not red.
